_schema: Standalone-optimization measured dispositions (review b51d1eb experiments). Candidate = working tree; baseline = pre-opt commit 020f429. Speedup = old/new (candidate faster), ORDER-VARIED paired trials, cross-process MEDIAN of 3 process replicates' per-coordinate paired-speedup medians. Correctness: I1/C1 proven BIT-EXACT vs baseline C++ (worst abs diff 0); I2 is representation-equivalent. Arithmetic acceptance (F4) is SEPARATE from these speed numbers and unchanged (PARTIAL). Standalone closure is NOT promotion.

provenance.head: 595c609
provenance.estimator: per coordinate: median of 5 order-varied paired (new,old) 30-call means per process; cross-process = median of the 3 process medians; spread = per-process [min,max] in the raw log

I1_indexer_bf16kv_drop_unused_alloc.change: allocate the Sb*D BF16 staging buffer only on the FP32-KV path (unused when KV arrives BF16)
I1_indexer_bf16kv_drop_unused_alloc.correctness: BIT-EXACT vs baseline (bf16-KV and fp32-KV paths, full M-sweep, worst abs diff 0)
I1_indexer_bf16kv_drop_unused_alloc.disposition: KEEP. Small but repeatable at large M (~3-4% M32/M64), neutral within noise at small M; free, reversible, zero numerical change. NOT a large win; magnitude was unknown and is small as the review anticipated.

I2_indexer_bf16kv_storage_contract.change: NONE (qualifies the existing BF16-KV path). Same bf16-rounded KV supplied as FP32 vs BF16; FP32 output in both.
I2_indexer_bf16kv_storage_contract.correctness: representation-equivalent (bf16-KV path already proven bit-exact to fp32-KV at the kernel's bf16 boundary)
I2_indexer_bf16kv_storage_contract.disposition: CONDITIONAL win (1.09-1.51x; largest at M1 1.44x and M64 1.51x) that realizes the ~46.7% KV-read reduction. REQUIRES the caller to supply BF16 KV -> an integration decision, DEFERRED. The FP32-input contract retains its own result; this is NOT a free speedup for every caller.

C1_compressor_one_exp.change: one std::exp per online update (the non-surviving softmax factor is exp(0)=1, hardcoded)
C1_compressor_one_exp.correctness: BIT-EXACT vs baseline C++ over 60 trials x 3 shapes incl masked/all-masked/ties (worst abs diff 0); F4 compressor max_err unchanged ~3.6e-7/5.96e-7
C1_compressor_one_exp.disposition: KEEP. Gain scales with R (exp count): R128 strong (1.29-1.62x), R8 moderate-to-small (1.0-1.21x), near-neutral at R8/M1 (fixed-cost bound). All medians >= ~1.0 (no regression; sub-1.0 only within the [min,max] spread). Bit-exact -> pure speed.

_provenance.estimator: cross-process median of 3 process replicates' per-coordinate order-varied paired medians

I3_indexer_weight_hoist.change: hoist the invariant per-head bf16 weight rounding out of the score-row loop (bit-exact)
I3_indexer_weight_hoist.disposition: NEUTRAL -> REVERTED. No measurable benefit (compiler already hoists / cost is immaterial vs GEMM+convert). Per the review's stopping rule (keep only on a repeatable measured benefit) the change was reverted; the shipped indexer is the I1-only version. ATTRIBUTION OUTCOME: the epilogue weight-rounding is NOT a material standalone cost.

C2_compressor_vector_exp.change: vectorized one-exp online-softmax via ATen vec exp (NOT bit-exact; F4-screened <=7e-7 vs oracle)
C2_compressor_vector_exp.disposition: REJECTED. ATen Vectorized::exp is SLOWER than scalar std::exp at every coordinate (blendv overhead + the vector polynomial is not a win here). Retain the scalar C1. Function kept as a labelled EXPERIMENTAL variant (not in the shipped path), matching the amx precedent.

C3_compressor_multipass.change: stable two-pass pooling (max over R, one exp/elem, divide once; NOT bit-exact; screened <=7e-7)
C3_compressor_multipass.disposition: NOT PROMOTED. A small win only at R128 large-M (~1.08-1.14x); neutral or slight loss at R8 and small M. Does not DECISIVELY beat the stronger (bit-exact) C1 baseline, and it is not bit-exact -> retain C1. Function kept as a labelled EXPERIMENTAL variant.

S1_sparse_blockwise_bf16.change: source-faithful 64-block bf16-in/fp32-out brgemm flash (sparse_attend_blockbf16); F4-screened within 4e-3 vs the blockwise ref (worst mae 3.9e-3, cos ~0.9999)
S1_sparse_blockwise_bf16.note: spd<1 => S1 SLOWER; S1 is 1.6x (K160/M64) to 12.8x (K640/M1) SLOWER than the shipped fp32-bmm donor at EVERY (M,K).
S1_sparse_blockwise_bf16.disposition: REJECTED (measured loss, the review's anticipated outcome). The per-64-block transpose + two packs + two small brgemms (x K/64 blocks) plus per-block fp32 rescale overwhelm the two large MKL bmms of the fp32-bmm donor at these dims. Retain the shipped best-of (scalar/fp32bmm). The AMX pack ukernel caps N at 64, forcing the transposed framing and many micro-GEMMs -- a concrete structural reason blockwise bf16 does not pay off standalone here. Kept as a labelled EXPERIMENTAL + correctness-screened path (like amx), not wired into dispatch.

_summary: Step 2 kept: I1 (small large-M), I2 (conditional bf16-KV), C1 (bit-exact exp halving). Step 3: I3 NEUTRAL (reverted), C2 REJECTED (slower), C3 NOT PROMOTED (marginal, non-bit-exact), S1 REJECTED (1.6-12.8x slower). Shipped kernels carry only measured wins (I1+C1). C2/C3/S1 retained as labelled experimental+screened variants, out of the shipped dispatch. F4 PARTIAL unchanged; standalone closure != promotion; no dispatch tuning / E2E this phase.
